title: Dossier Authoring Evidence Schema
description: JSON Schema for a dossier's authoring-evidence sidecar record — per-rule rationale plus pointers to the agent session(s) where the decision was made. Never loaded by `ai-dossier run`; keyed by the dossier's body checksum.

evidence_schema_version.description: Version of the Authoring Evidence Schema specification being used

version.description: Semantic version of the dossier this evidence record applies to

checksum.description: Body checksum of the dossier version this evidence record applies to

hash.description: SHA256 hash of dossier body content (after frontmatter)

anchor.description: Free text naming the rule/heading in the dossier body this entry documents

rationale.description: Short rationale for why the rule/section reads the way it does

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this entry was recorded

evidence.description: Pointers to the agent session(s) where this decision was made

provider.description: Agent provider that produced the session

session.description: Provider-native session id (e.g. Claude Code's session UUID)

event.description: Provider-native per-message/tool-call id within the session

host.description: Machine the session ran on (evidence refs are only resolvable there)

extra.description: Optional tool-specific locator IDs (e.g. ctx); never the only locator
